verdict.rationale: Portkey's docs explicitly position it as a unified interface to 250+ (and elsewhere 1,600+) models. One API key reaches multiple providers, the base URL is OpenAI-SDK compatible, models are addressed as `@provider-slug/model-name`, and AWS, Azure, Vertex and on-prem models (vLLM, Ollama) sit behind a single unified API. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the API behaves consistently across providers (all evidence is vendor docs).
